title: Serengeti & Ngorongoro Crater Safari
bestTimeToGo: June to October for the Great Migration; December to March for calving season
highlights: Witness the world-famous Serengeti — home to the Great Migration
Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Spot the Big Five: lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, and rhino
Stay in safari lodges and tented camps in the heart of the wilderness
Experience the vast Serengeti plains stretching to the horizon
All flights, game drives, accommodation, meals, and park fees included
includes: Return flights Zanzibar – Arusha (or Dar es Salaam connection)
All ground transportation in 4x4 safari vehicle
Ngorongoro Conservation Area entrance and crater service fees
Safari lodge or tented camp accommodation (full board)
excludes: Gratuities for guide and lodge staff
Optional hot air balloon safari over the Serengeti

itinerary.dayBody: Morning flight from Zanzibar to Arusha, the gateway to Tanzania’s northern safari circuit. Meet your safari guide and begin the drive towards the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Enjoy the dramatic landscape change from tropical coast to highland savannah. Overnight at a lodge on the rim of the Ngorongoro Crater with breathtaking views.

Descend 600 metres into the Ngorongoro Crater — the world’s largest intact volcanic caldera and one of Africa’s most spectacular wildlife viewing areas. The crater floor is home to an astonishing concentration of wildlife including lions, elephants, hippos, flamingos, and the critically endangered black rhino. Spend a full day exploring this natural wonder before ascending back to the rim.

Drive across the stunning Serengeti plains — an endless expanse of grassland, acacia woodland, and kopje rock formations. Depending on the season, witness the Great Migration — millions of wildebeest, zebra, and gazelle moving across the landscape. Daily game drives take you deep into the park to spot big cats, elephant herds, cheetahs, and an incredible diversity of birdlife. Evenings are spent at your safari camp, dining under the stars and listening to the sounds of the African bush.

After a final morning game drive, transfer to the airstrip for your flight back to Zanzibar. Arrive back on the island in time for a sunset on the beach — the perfect way to reflect on an extraordinary safari adventure.

whatToBring: Warm jacket and fleece for Ngorongoro rim (it gets cold at altitude)
pickupInfo: Zanzibar hotel pickup for airport transfer included. Full briefing provided the evening before departure.
cancellationPolicyShort: Free cancellation up to 14 days before departure. 50% refund for cancellations 7–13 days before.

seo.description: Experience the world-famous Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater on a premium safari from Zanzibar. Spot the Big Five, witness the Great Migration, all-inclusive package.

content:
This is the safari of a lifetime — combining the world-famous Serengeti National Park with the awe-inspiring Ngorongoro Crater, all arranged seamlessly from your Zanzibar base.

The Serengeti needs no introduction. This is where the Great Migration unfolds — over two million wildebeest, zebra, and gazelle moving in a vast, ancient cycle across the golden plains. It’s where prides of lions laze in the shade of acacia trees, cheetahs sprint across open grassland, and the African sunset paints the sky in colours you’ve never seen before.

The Ngorongoro Crater is equally extraordinary — a collapsed volcano whose floor has become one of the densest wildlife habitats on Earth. Here, in a natural arena ringed by 600-metre walls, you’ll find every major African species including the elusive black rhino.

This all-inclusive package takes care of everything: flights from Zanzibar, 4x4 game drives with an expert guide, comfortable safari accommodation, all meals, and every park fee. You just need to bring your sense of wonder.
